A few solid reasons Grok Bot edges Meta Muse for many:

It runs multiple specialized teammates in parallel on one persistent cloud computer that signs into your actual tools and finishes multi-step work while you are away.

You can teach any routine by simply showing it once, then schedule it to run autonomously.

Built on Grok models that prioritize maximum truth-seeking with fewer content filters.
